scope: Retained-evidence/source audit only; no benchmarks, upload, dependency changes or GPU sessions
missing_definition: No matching real-T4 evidence found for the stated current variant in the inspected records; not proof an inaccessible remote run never occurred
qualification_blocker: Frozen Linux platform lock/wheelhouse/ABI and TileLang 0.1.13 SM75 qualification not established; historical gate still selects 0.1.15

validation_dimensions.family: FP16-fix residual flow and weight folding
validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: Local trained component checks, 38 configurations against the existing Native FP32 flow; no T4
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: SM75 finite/overflow/underflow behavior and state/output fidelity for current TE/DiT shapes, including LoRA. Keep INT8 operators in the reference; do not replace them with dense FP32

validation_dimensions.family: Actual FP16 dispatch through Group32 / packed rows / SwiGLU / owned-FP32 FC2
validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: The FP32 variants have historical T4 results; local SM120 uses native fallbacks
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: Trace which backend actually runs with FP16 activations, validate it and measure complete APIs. Several row/SwiGLU/transport helpers have FP32 guards, so earlier FP32 speedups cannot be assumed to apply

validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: P2 codec/fused epilogues were tested on T4 for historical DiT FP32 boundaries; the later four-site row integration has local M=17 logical-rank gates
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: Physical NCCL + current wrappers for TE O/down and DiT O/FC2, independent codec reference, cancellation-sensitive inputs and realistic row counts. The wrapper's FP32 eligibility also needs to be reported under the default FP16 flow

validation_dimensions.family: Native Token Refiner SDPA wrapper and explicit TE attention/MLP lifetime deletion
validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: CPU/local wiring and lifetime checks; native SDPA itself is not a new untested primitive
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: Current integrated SM75 dispatch, output correctness and peak-memory/lifetime behavior. No new target performance result for these particular changes is recorded

validation_dimensions.family: Current `adaptive_lookahead` option and its 1–2-group admission behavior
validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: Local fixture/ownership tests; older adaptive streaming has historical physical results
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: Current flag/wiring, current memory policy and FP16 workspace coexistence on two devices. The older adaptive run does not establish a stable speedup for this flag/version

validation_dimensions.family: Whole-layer offline LoRA baking on two physical GPUs
validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: Serial/spawned CPU checks and two spawned CUDA workers sharing one 5060 Ti; exact sampled weight/scale bytes
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: Two distinct T4 devices, layer ownership, output artifact identity, peak VRAM/RAM and baking throughput. Older offline-LoRA checkpoints/generation results do not validate this newer layer-parallel baker

validation_dimensions.family: Encoder-first/decoder-last VAE loading and idle VAE-encoder + TE preload
validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: Trained local Video/Audio component checks; local cancellation, pressure and host-budget fixtures
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: Actual parent/worker coexistence, Native model-management lifetime, decoder loading and cancellation on dual T4. Keep Audio Native single-GPU; no full H3 request is required for a bounded component gate

validation_dimensions.family: Current pinned Video query/fallback path and Native-only Audio wrapper
validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: Latest local Video gate: 36 Native / 72 logical-parallel calls. Trained local Audio output is exact for both auto/native; no audio-worker dispatch
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: SM75 regression of the current source/legacy API, staged Native fallback and single-GPU Audio decode. Video query parallelism and Native audio both have historical T4 evidence; this is current-integration requalification, not a new algorithm

validation_dimensions.existing_evidence: CPU positional-read fixtures and Windows fallback; earlier T4 I/O studies used their own saved readers
validation_dimensions.remaining_check: Native Linux file descriptors, short reads, current range layout and target-filesystem behavior. This is primarily a CPU/OS/I/O experiment, not a reason to consume T4 time

planned_not_integrated: TE compressed-weight streaming: CPU codec screen exists, loader does not
Bounded cross-stage streaming planner: revised design only
deferred_or_blocked: Full H3 sparse semantics / FP16 trajectories / approximate transport quality
Large idle matrix and physical model-switch/interruption
